en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a large parade moving down a broad avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings. Crowds of spectators stand on both sides of the street and on balconies. At the center, several people in traditional folk clothing carry large framed portraits and a smaller framed image, as well as flags. A suited man in a hat walks in the foreground. In the distance a banner with Cyrillic text is visible above the crowd.
